mapper.select: select A.id, B.name_eng as 'NAME_ENG_ORG', C.name_eng as 'NAME_ENG_ROOM', A.timeslot_start, A.timeslot_end, D.name_eng as 'NAME_ENG_USER', A.updated_datetime, A.updated_by from booking_appointment A inner join org_profile B on B.org_id = A.org_id inner join room_profile C on C.org_id = A.org_id and C.room_id = A.room_id inner join user_profile D on D.org_id = A.org_id and D.user_id = A.user_id where A.timeslot_start >= NOW() + INTERVAL 2 HOUR order by A.timeslot_start
select B.name_eng from users A inner join user_profile B on B.org_id = A.org_id and B.user_id = A.user_id where A.username = #{username}
mapper.update: update booking_appointment set user_id = ( select user_id from users where username = #{nameEngUser} ), owner_id = ( select user_id from users where username = #{nameEngUser} ), updated_by = ( select B.name_eng from users A inner join user_profile B on B.org_id = A.org_id and B.user_id = A.user_id where A.username = #{nameEngUser} ), updated_datetime = NOW() where user_id = 0 and org_id = ( select org_id from org_profile where name_eng = #{nameEngOrg} ) and room_id = ( select room_id from room_profile where name_eng = #{nameEngRoom} ) and timeslot_start = #{timeslotStart} and timeslot_end = #{timeslotEnd} and timeslot_start >= NOW() + INTERVAL 2 HOUR

update booking_appointment set user_id = 0, owner_id = 0, updated_by = ( select B.name_eng from users A inner join user_profile B on B.org_id = A.org_id and B.user_id = A.user_id where A.username = #{nameEngUser} ), updated_datetime = NOW() where org_id = ( select org_id from org_profile where name_eng = #{nameEngOrg} ) and room_id = ( select room_id from room_profile where name_eng = #{nameEngRoom} ) and timeslot_start = #{timeslotStart} and timeslot_end = #{timeslotEnd} and timeslot_start >= NOW() + INTERVAL 2 HOUR and ( exists( select username from users where username = #{nameEngUser} and role = 'ROLE_ADMIN' ) or ( user_id = ( select user_id from users where username = #{nameEngUser} ) ) )
